job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is SBCERS’ private equity consultant RFP, not LACERS’ actuarial RFP. Its experience requirement concerns a key private equity professional, not a lead actuary, and it does not support the required LACERS experience thresholds.
quotes: SANTA BARBARA COUNTY EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) FOR DISCRETIONARY PRIVATE EQUITY CONSULTANT SERVICES

At least one key professional member of the firm assigned to SBCERS’ account must have a minimum of ten (10) years of experience (three (3) of which have been with the current firm) recommending investing in Private Equity investment programs for institutional clients.
